note: The bar each arcade game's rung is checked against, from human flight records. min_finish: the least share of human flights that finish the rung (max_finish, optional: the most, for a rung that must challenge). seconds: the band a finished run's median time should fall in. The defaults are wide on time because games differ (Switchback I2 runs about 220 s); a game narrows them under 'games' (mode name -> rung -> fields), and a rung's bar is LEARNED from the fun card once three runs of it were rated 'right' for the rung (rung_bars.py replaces min_finish and seconds then). The finish rates come from the playbook's proposed bars: I1 a first-time pilot finishes, I2 the fun bar holds, I3 a skilled pilot finishes, I4 the best finish near the limit.
